1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 mailbox v2 logical channels used by AP bring-up and logging.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
15: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
16: 
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
18: 
19: #define MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL_TX 0x10u
20: #define MB_CHNL_PWC_TX     0x12u
21: #define MB_CHNL_UART0_TX   0x19u
22: #define MB_CHNL_PWC_RX     0x42u
23: #define MB_CHNL_UART0_RX   0x49u
24: 
25: #define MB_UART_SEND_DATA  0u
26: #define MB_UART_SEND_STATE 1u
27: 
28: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX  0x01u
29: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX  0x02u
30: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET    0x04u
31: #define CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL 0x01u
32: 
33: #define CP_RAM_START       0x28064000u
34: #define CP_RAM_END         0x2809f700u
35: #define UART_XCHG_SIZE     128u
36: #define UART_TX_SIZE       1024u
37: #define PHY_BUSY_TIMEOUT   MSEC2TICK(200)
38: #define TX_RETRY_INTERVAL  MSEC2TICK(10)
39: 
40: struct mb_message
41: {
42:   uint32_t header;
43:   uint32_t param1;
44:   uint32_t param2;
45:   uint32_t param3;
46: };
47: 
48: struct logical_channel
49: {
50:   struct mb_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
51:   bool pending;
52: };
53: 
54: struct mailbox_stats
55: {
56:   uint32_t tx_count;
57:   uint32_t rx_count;
58:   uint32_t fifo_full;
59:   uint32_t ack_timeout;
60:   uint32_t bad_envelope;
61:   uint32_t bad_ack;
62:   uint32_t reset_count;
63:   uint32_t uart_drop;
64:   uint32_t uart_tx_fail;
65: };
66: 
67: static struct logical_channel g_channels[3];
68: static const uint8_t g_channel_ids[3] =
69: {
70:   MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL_TX,
71:   MB_CHNL_PWC_TX,
72:   MB_CHNL_UART0_TX
73: };
74: static uint8_t g_uart_tx[UART_TX_SIZE];
75: static uint8_t g_uart_xchg[UART_XCHG_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(32)));
76: static struct mb_message g_ack_message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
77: static uint32_t g_ack_wire[2];
78: static uint16_t g_uart_read;
79: static uint16_t g_uart_write;
80: static uint16_t g_uart_inflight;
81: static uint8_t g_tx_seq;
82: static uint8_t g_active_channel;
83: static uint8_t g_active_seq;
84: static bool g_phy_busy;
85: static bool g_initialized;
86: static bool g_serial_kick;
87: static clock_t g_busy_since;
88: static clock_t g_uart_retry_after;
89: static struct mailbox_stats g_stats;
90: static sem_t g_tx_sem;
91: static void (*g_pwc_rx)(const struct mb_message *message);
92: 
93: extern void bk7258_serial_tx_available(void);
94: 
95: static unsigned int channel_index(uint8_t logical_channel)
96: {
97:   unsigned int i;
98: 
99:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(g_channel_ids); i++)
100:     {
101:       if (g_channel_ids[i] == logical_channel)
102:         {
103:           return i;
104:         }
105:     }
106: 
107:   return sizeof(g_channel_ids);
108: }
109: 
110: static uint16_t uart_count(void)
111: {
112:   if (g_uart_write >= g_uart_read)
113:     {
114:       return g_uart_write - g_uart_read;
115:     }
116: 
117:   return UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart_read + g_uart_write;
118: }
119: 
120: static void uart_prepare(void)
121: {
122:   struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[2];
123:   uint16_t count;
124:   uint16_t first;
125: 
126:   if (channel->pending || g_uart_inflight != 0)
127:     {
128:       return;
129:     }
130: 
131:   if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - g_uart_retry_after) < 0)
132:     {
133:       return;
134:     }
135: 
136:   count = uart_count();
137:   if (count == 0)
138:     {
139:       return;
140:     }
141: 
142:   if (count > UART_XCHG_SIZE)
143:     {
144:       count = UART_XCHG_SIZE;
145:     }
146: 
147:   first = UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart_read;
148:   if (first > count)
149:     {
150:       first = count;
151:     }
152: 
153:   memcpy(g_uart_xchg, &g_uart_tx[g_uart_read], first);
154:   if (first != count)
155:     {
156:       memcpy(&g_uart_xchg[first], g_uart_tx, count - first);
157:     }
158: 
159:   channel->message.header = 0; /* MB_UART_SEND_DATA */
160:   channel->message.param1 = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)g_uart_xchg;
161:   channel->message.param2 = count;
162:   channel->message.param3 = 0; /* RTS deasserted, CRC disabled by Armino. */
163:   channel->pending = true;
164:   g_uart_inflight = count;
165: }
166: 
167: static int dispatch_locked(void)
168: {
169:   struct logical_channel *channel;
170:   uint32_t wire[2];
171:   clock_t now;
172:   unsigned int i;
173:   int ret;
174: 
175:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
176:   if (g_phy_busy && now - g_busy_since >= PHY_BUSY_TIMEOUT)
177:     {
178:       g_stats.ack_timeout++;
179:       g_phy_busy = false;
180:     }
181: 
182:   if (g_phy_busy)
183:     {
184:       return OK;
185:     }
186: 
187:   if (g_ack_wire[0] != 0)
188:     {
189:       ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, g_ack_wire);
190:       if (ret < 0)
191:         {
192:           if (ret == -EAGAIN)
193:             {
194:               g_stats.fifo_full++;
195:             }
196: 
197:           return ret;
198:         }
199: 
200:       g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
201:       g_stats.tx_count++;
202:     }
203: 
204:   uart_prepare();
205:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(g_channel_ids); i++)
206:     {
207:       channel = &g_channels[i];
208:       if (!channel->pending)
209:         {
210:           continue;
211:         }
212: 
213:       g_active_channel = g_channel_ids[i];
214:       g_active_seq = ++g_tx_seq;
215:       channel->message.header &= 0xffu;
216:       channel->message.header |= (uint32_t)g_active_seq << 16;
217:       channel->message.header |= (uint32_t)g_active_channel << 24;
218:       wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&channel->message;
219:       wire[1] = sizeof(channel->message);
220:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
221:       ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
222:       if (ret < 0)
223:         {
224:           if (ret == -EAGAIN)
225:             {
226:               g_stats.fifo_full++;
227:             }
228: 
229:           return ret;
230:         }
231: 
232:       g_phy_busy = true;
233:       g_busy_since = now;
234:       g_stats.tx_count++;
235:       return OK;
236:     }
237: 
238:   return OK;
239: }

241: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
242: {
243:   irqstate_t flags;
244: 
245:   (void)argc;
246:   (void)argv;
247:   for (;;)
248:     {
249:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, TX_RETRY_INTERVAL);
250: 
251:       flags = up_irq_save();
252:       if (g_serial_kick)
253:         {
254:           g_serial_kick = false;
255:           up_irq_restore(flags);
256:           bk7258_serial_tx_available();
257:           flags = up_irq_save();
258:         }
259: 
260:       (void)dispatch_locked();
261:       up_irq_restore(flags);
262:     }
263: 
264:   return OK;
265: }
266: 
267: static int queue_message(uint8_t logical_channel, uint8_t command,
268:                          uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2, uint32_t p3)
269: {
270:   struct logical_channel *channel;
271:   irqstate_t flags;
272:   unsigned int index;
273:   int ret;
274: 
275:   if (!g_initialized)
276:     {
277:       return -EAGAIN;
278:     }
279: 
280:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
281:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids))
282:     {
283:       return -EINVAL;
284:     }
285: 
286:   flags = up_irq_save();
287:   channel = &g_channels[index];
288:   if (channel->pending)
289:     {
290:       up_irq_restore(flags);
291:       return -EBUSY;
292:     }
293: 
294:   channel->message.header = command;
295:   channel->message.param1 = p1;
296:   channel->message.param2 = p2;
297:   channel->message.param3 = p3;
298:   channel->pending = true;
299:   ret = dispatch_locked();
300:   up_irq_restore(flags);
301:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
302:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
303: }
304: 
305: static bool valid_cp_message(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire,
306:                              uintptr_t *address)
307: {
308:   *address = wire->data[0];
309:   /* Armino's mbox0_adapter mailbox_buff is an array of 16-byte messages in
310:    * CP .bss and is only word-aligned; 32-byte alignment is reserved for the
311:    * separate exchange payload buffers. */
312:   return wire->src_cpu == 0 && wire->data[1] == sizeof(struct mb_message) &&
313:          (*address & 3u) == 0 && *address >= CP_RAM_START &&
314:          *address <= CP_RAM_END - sizeof(struct mb_message);
315: }
316: 
317: static void handle_ack(struct mb_message *message)
318: {
319:   uint8_t logical_channel = message->header >> 24;
320:   uint8_t sequence = message->header >> 16;
321:   bool uart_failed;
322:   unsigned int index;
323: 
324:   if ((message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_RESET << 12)) != 0)
325:     {
326:       g_stats.reset_count++;
327:       g_phy_busy = false;
328:       (void)dispatch_locked();
329:       return;
330:     }
331: 
332:   if (logical_channel != g_active_channel || sequence != g_active_seq)
333:     {
334:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
335:       g_phy_busy = false;
336:       (void)dispatch_locked();
337:       return;
338:     }
339: 
340:   index = channel_index(g_active_channel);
341:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids) || !g_channels[index].pending)
342:     {
343:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
344:       g_phy_busy = false;
345:       (void)dispatch_locked();
346:       return;
347:     }
348: 
349:   g_channels[index].pending = false;
350:   if (g_active_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_TX)
351:     {
352:       uart_failed =
353:         (message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8)) != 0 ||
354:         (message->param1 & 2u) != 0;
355:       if (uart_failed)
356:         {
357:           g_stats.uart_tx_fail++;
358:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
359:           g_uart_retry_after = clock_systime_ticks() + TX_RETRY_INTERVAL;
360:         }
361:       else
362:         {
363:           g_uart_read = (g_uart_read + g_uart_inflight) % UART_TX_SIZE;
364:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
365:           g_uart_retry_after = 0;
366:           g_serial_kick = true;
367:         }
368: 
369:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
370:     }
371: 
372:   g_phy_busy = false;
373:   uart_prepare();
374:   (void)dispatch_locked();
375: }
376: 
377: static void mailbox_rx(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire)
378: {
379:   struct mb_message message;
380:   uintptr_t address;
381:   uint8_t control;
382:   uint8_t logical_channel;
383:   irqstate_t flags;
384: 
385:   if (!valid_cp_message(wire, &address))
386:     {
387:       g_stats.bad_envelope++;
388:       return;
389:     }
390: 
391:   memcpy(&message, (const void *)address, sizeof(message));
392:   control = (message.header >> 12) & 0x0fu;
393:   logical_channel = message.header >> 24;
394:   g_stats.rx_count++;
395: 
396:   flags = up_irq_save();
397:   if ((control & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
398:     {
399:       handle_ack(&message);
400:       up_irq_restore(flags);
401:       return;
402:     }
403: 
404:   if (logical_channel != MB_CHNL_PWC_RX &&
405:       logical_channel != MB_CHNL_UART0_RX)
406:     {
407:       g_stats.bad_envelope++;
408:       up_irq_restore(flags);
409:       return;
410:     }
411: 
412:   if (logical_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_RX)
413:     {
414:       /* This port is output-only, but Armino initializes MB_UART0 by sending
415:        * SEND_STATE from CP. Acknowledge its state/data commands with RTS
416:        * deasserted so the CP endpoint reaches ready without enabling input. */
417:       if ((message.header & 0xffu) != MB_UART_SEND_DATA &&
418:           (message.header & 0xffu) != MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
419:         {
420:           message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
421:         }
422: 
423:       message.param1 = 0; /* uart_rts=0, uart_tx_fail=0 */
424:       message.param2 = 0;
425:       message.param3 = 0;
426:     }
427: 
428:   if ((control & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
429:     {
430:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX << 12;
431:       memcpy((void *)address, &message, sizeof(message));
432:       memcpy(&g_ack_message, &message, sizeof(g_ack_message));
433:       g_ack_wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&g_ack_message;
434:       g_ack_wire[1] = sizeof(g_ack_message);
435:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
436:       if (bk7258_mbox_send(0, g_ack_wire) < 0)
437:         {
438:           g_stats.fifo_full++;
439:           nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
440:         }
441:       else
442:         {
443:           g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
444:           g_stats.tx_count++;
445:         }
446: 
447:       message.header &= ~((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX << 12);
448:     }
449: 
450:   if (logical_channel == MB_CHNL_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
451:     {
452:       g_pwc_rx(&message);
453:     }
454: 
455:   up_irq_restore(flags);
456: }
457: 
458: void bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(void (*callback)(const void *message))
459: {
460:   g_pwc_rx = (void (*)(const struct mb_message *))callback;
461: }
462: 
463: int bk7258_mailbox_init(void)
464: {
465:   int ret;
466: 
467:   memset(g_channels, 0, sizeof(g_channels));
468:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
469:   g_uart_read = 0;
470:   g_uart_write = 0;
471:   g_uart_inflight = 0;
472:   g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
473:   g_serial_kick = false;
474:   g_phy_busy = false;
475:   g_uart_retry_after = 0;
476:   g_pwc_rx = NULL;
477:   g_initialized = false;
478: 
479:   nxsem_init(&g_tx_sem, 0, 0);
480:   bk7258_mbox_set_callback(mailbox_rx);
481: 
482:   ret = bk7258_mbox_init();
483:   if (ret < 0)
484:     {
485:       return ret;
486:     }
487: 
488:   ret = kthread_create("mbox-tx", 105, 1536, mailbox_tx_worker, NULL);
489:   if (ret < 0)
490:     {
491:       return ret;
492:     }
493: 
494:   g_initialized = true;
495:   g_serial_kick = true;
496:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
497:   return OK;
498: }
499: 
500: int bk7258_mbox_send_message(uint8_t command, uint8_t logical_channel,
501:                              uint32_t param1, uint32_t param2,
502:                              uint32_t param3)
503: {
504:   return queue_message(logical_channel, command, param1, param2, param3);
505: }
506: 
507: int bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(uint8_t command, uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2,
508:                             uint32_t p3)
509: {
510:   return queue_message(MB_CHNL_PWC_TX, command, p1, p2, p3);
511: }
512: 
513: int bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, uint16_t length)
514: {
515:   irqstate_t flags;
516:   uint16_t written = 0;
517: 
518:   if (data == NULL || length == 0 || !g_initialized)
519:     {
520:       return -EINVAL;
521:     }
522: 
523:   flags = up_irq_save();
524:   while (written < length)
525:     {
526:       uint16_t next = (g_uart_write + 1u) % UART_TX_SIZE;
527:       if (next == g_uart_read)
528:         {
529:           g_stats.uart_drop += length - written;
530:           break;
531:         }
532: 
533:       g_uart_tx[g_uart_write] = data[written++];
534:       g_uart_write = next;
535:     }
536: 
537:   uart_prepare();
538:   (void)dispatch_locked();
539:   up_irq_restore(flags);
540:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
541:   return written == length ? OK : -ENOSPC;
542: }
543: 
544: bool bk7258_mbox_uart_txready(void)
545: {
546:   irqstate_t flags;
547:   bool ready;
548: 
549:   flags = up_irq_save();
550:   ready = g_initialized && (g_uart_write + 1u) % UART_TX_SIZE != g_uart_read;
551:   up_irq_restore(flags);
552:   return ready;
553: }
554: 
555: bool bk7258_mbox_uart_txempty(void)
556: {
557:   irqstate_t flags;
558:   bool empty;
559: 
560:   flags = up_irq_save();
561:   empty = g_initialized && g_uart_read == g_uart_write &&
562:           g_uart_inflight == 0;
563:   up_irq_restore(flags);
564:   return empty;
565: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: #include <string.h>
9: 
10: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
11: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
12: #include <sys/param.h>
13: #include "arm_internal.h"
14: 
15: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
17: #include "irq.h"
18: 
19: #define MBOX_REG(n) (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
20: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG MBOX_REG(0x20)
21: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG MBOX_REG(0x21)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x22)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x23)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TID MBOX_REG(0x24)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_SID MBOX_REG(0x25)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x26)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x27)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x28)
29: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x18)
30: #define MBOX_CTRL MBOX_REG(2)
31: #define MBOX_INT_STATUS MBOX_REG(3)
32: 
33: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
34: static bool g_mbox_ready;
35: 
36: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
37: {
38:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
39: }
40: 
41: int bk7258_mbox_receive(bk7258_mbox_message_t *message)
42: {
43:   if (message == NULL || (bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) != 0)
44:     {
45:       return -EINVAL;
46:     }
47: 
48:   message->src_cpu = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0xfu;
49:   message->data[0] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
50:   message->data[1] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
51:   return OK;
52: }
53: 
54: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
55: {
56:   /* TX uses the CPU1-owned channel 1 registers, while the destination FIFO
57:    * full state is reported by the destination channel (CPU0 is channel 0). */
58:   if (destination > 2 || data == NULL ||
59:       (getreg32(destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS : MBOX_CH1_STATUS) & 1u) != 0)
60:     {
61:       return -EAGAIN;
62:     }
63: 
64:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
65:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
66:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
67:   return OK;
68: }
69: 
70: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
71: {
72:   bk7258_mbox_message_t message;
73:   (void)irq;
74:   (void)context;
75:   (void)arg;
76: 
77:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
78:     {
79:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&message) != OK)
80:         {
81:           break;
82:         }
83:       if (g_callback != NULL)
84:         {
85:           g_callback(&message);
86:         }
87:     }
88:   return OK;
89: }
90: 
91: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
92: {
93:   g_callback = callback;
94: }
95: 
96: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
97: {
98:   int ret;
99: 
100:   g_mbox_ready = false;
101:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1: FIFO starts at 2 and has three entries. */
102:   /* Channel 1 owns FIFO entries 2..4.  The start and length fields live in
103:    * separate registers on mailbox v2. */
104:   putreg32(2u | (1u << 8), MBOX_CH1_CFG);
105:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
106:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
107:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
108:   if (ret < 0)
109:     {
110:       return ret;
111:     }
112:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
113:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
114:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
115:     {
116:       bk7258_mbox_message_t ignored;
117:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&ignored) != OK)
118:         {
119:           break;
120:         }
121:     }
122: 
123:   g_mbox_ready = true;
124:   return OK;
125: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: 
9: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
10: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
11: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
12: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
13: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
14: 
15: int bk7258_mailbox_init(void);
16: int bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(uint8_t command, uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2,
17:                             uint32_t p3);
18: void bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(void (*callback)(const void *message));
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: 
21: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
22: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
23: 
24: struct pwc_message
25: {
26:   uint32_t header;
27:   uint32_t param1;
28:   uint32_t param2;
29:   uint32_t param3;
30: };
31: 
32: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
33: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
34: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
35: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
36: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
37: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
38: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
39: 
40: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
41: {
42:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
43: 
44:   (void)argc;
45:   (void)argv;
46:   for (;;)
47:     {
48:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
49:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
50:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
51:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
52:     }
53:   return 0;
54: }
55: 
56: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
57: {
58:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
59:   struct pwc_message message;
60:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
61:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
62:     {
63:       return;
64:     }
65:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
66:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
67:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
68:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
69:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
70:   g_head = next;
71:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
72: }
73: 
74: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
75: {
76:   (void)argc;
77:   (void)argv;
78:   g_worker_ready = true;
79:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
80:   for (;;)
81:     {
82:       struct pwc_message message;
83:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
84:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
85:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
86:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
87:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
88:         {
89:           case 0x7u: /* PSRAM power request: CP owns the PHY transition. */
90:           case 0xau: /* AP recovery request. */
91:           case 0x8u: /* allocator state query. */
92:           case 0x9u: /* allocator diagnostics query. */
93:             break;
94:           default:
95:             break;
96:         }
97:     }
98:   return 0;
99: }
100: 
101: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
102: {
103:   int pid;
104:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
105:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
106:   g_head = 0;
107:   g_tail = 0;
108:   g_worker_ready = false;
109:   g_ready_sent = false;
110:   pid = bk7258_mailbox_init();
111:   if (pid < 0)
112:     {
113:       return pid;
114:     }
115:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
116:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
117:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
118:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
119:     {
120:       return -1;
121:     }
122:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
123:                      NULL) < 0)
124:     {
125:       return -1;
126:     }
127:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
128:   if (pid < 0)
129:     {
130:       return pid;
131:     }
132:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
133:       !g_worker_ready)
134:     {
135:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
136:     }
137:   if (!g_ready_sent)
138:     {
139:       g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD, 1, 0, 0) == 0;
140:     }
141:   return g_ready_sent ? 0 : -1;
142: }

23: #define MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL		(MAILBOX_BOX0)
24: #define MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL		(MAILBOX_BOX1)
25: 
26: #define CHNL_STATE_BUSY		1
27: #define CHNL_STATE_IDLE		0
28: 
29: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
30:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
31:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
32:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
33:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
34: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
35: 
36: typedef struct
37: {
38: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
39: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
40: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
41: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
42: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
43: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
44: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
45: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
46: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
47: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
48: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
49: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;
50: 
51: 
52: #define CHNL_CTRL_MASK			0xF
53: /*
54:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
55:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
56:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
57:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
58:  */
59: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX		0x01
60: 
61: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX		0x02
62: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET			0x04
63: 
64: typedef union
65: {
66: 	struct
67: 	{
68: 		u32		cmd            : 8;
69: 		u32		state          : 4;
70: 		u32		ctrl           : 4;
71: 		u32		tx_seq         : 8;
72: 		u32		logical_chnl   : 8;
73: 	} ;
74: 	u32		data;
75: } phy_chnnl_hdr_t;
76: 
77: typedef struct
78: {
79: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
80: 
81: 	u32		param1;
82: 	u32		param2;
83: 	u32		param3;
84: } mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t;
85: 
86: typedef struct
87: {
88: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
89: 
90: 	u32		data1;
91: 	u32		data2;
92: 	u32		data3;
93: } mb_phy_chnl_ack_t;
94: 
95: typedef union
96: {
97: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t		phy_ch_hdr;
98: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	phy_ch_cmd;
99: 	mb_phy_chnl_ack_t	phy_ch_ack;
100: 	mailbox_data_t		mb_data;
101: } mb_phy_chnl_union_t;
102: 
103: typedef struct
104: {
105: 	volatile u8		tx_state;				/* logical channel tx state. */
106: 	u8				in_used;
107: 	chnl_rx_isr_t		rx_isr;
108: 	chnl_tx_isr_t		tx_isr;
109: 	chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t	tx_cmpl_isr;
110: 	void *				isr_param;
111: 	mailbox_data_t		chnnl_tx_buff;		/* logical channel tx buffer. */
112: } mb_log_chnl_cb_t;

183: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
184: {
185: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;

187: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
188: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);

194: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
195: {
196: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
197: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
198: 	u16 			chnl_type;
199: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
200: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
201: 
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
203: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
204: 
205: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
206: 		return 4;
207: 
208: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
209: 		return 5;
210: 
211: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
212: 		return 3;
213: 
214: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }

259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;
460: }

462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
465: 
466: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
467: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
468: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
470: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
472: 
473: 	/*
474: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
475: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
476: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
477: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
478: 	 */
479: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
480: 	{
481: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
482: 	}
483: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
484: 	{
485: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
486: 	}
487: }

489: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
490: {
491: 	u8		ret_code;
492: 
493: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
494: 
495: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
496: 
497: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return;
504: 
505: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
506: 
507: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
511: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
512: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
513: 
514: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != 0)
517: 		{
518: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
519: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
520: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
521: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
522: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
523: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
524: 
525: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
526: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
527: 			}
528: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
529: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
530: 		}
531: 	}
532: 
533: 	return;
534: }

536: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
537: 
538: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
539: {
540: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
541: 	u16 			chnl_type;
542: 
543: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
544: 
545: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
546: 
547: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
548: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
549: 
550: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
551: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
552: 
553: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
554: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
555: 
556: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
557: 
558: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
559: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
560: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
561: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
562: 
563: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
564: 
565: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
566: 
567: 	/*
568: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
569: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
570: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
571: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
572: 	 */
573: 	while(1)
574: 	{
575: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
576: 
577: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
578: 		{
579: 			break;
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 
583: 	return ret_code;
584: }

586: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_reset(u8 dst_cpu)
587: {
588: 	u16 				chnl_type;
589: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	cmd_buf = {0};
590: 
591: 	if(SELF_CPU == dst_cpu)
592: 	{
593: 		return BK_OK;
594: 	}
595: 
596: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
597: 
598: 	cmd_buf.hdr.data = 0;
599: 	cmd_buf.hdr.ctrl |= (CHNL_CTRL_RESET | CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX);
600: 	cmd_buf.hdr.logical_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU);
601: 
602: 	bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)&cmd_buf, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
603: 
604: 	return BK_OK;
605: }

607: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
608: /*
609:   * init logical chnanel module.
610:   * return:
611:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
612:   *     failed  : fail code.
613:   *
614:   */
615: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
616: {
617: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
618: 	int				i, j;
619: 
620: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
621: 
622: 	/*
623: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
624: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
625: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
626: 	 * can race here:
627: 	 *
628: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
629: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
630: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
631: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
632: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
633: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
634: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
635: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
636: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
637: 	 *
638: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
639: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
640: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
641: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
642: 	 */
643: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
644: 	{
645: 		return BK_OK;
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
649: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
650: 	{
651: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
652: 		return BK_OK;
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
656: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
657: 	{
658: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
659: 
660: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
661: 
662: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
663: 
664: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
665: 		{
666: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
671: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
672: 	{
673: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
674: 		return ret_code;
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
678: 
679: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
680: 	{
681: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
682: 
683: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
684: 	}
685: 
686: 	mb_phy_chnl_reset(0);
687: 
688: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
689: 
690: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
691: 
692: 	return BK_OK;
693: }
694: 
695: /*
696:   * open logical chnanel.
697:   * input:
698:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
699:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.
700:   * return:
701:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
702:   *     failed  : fail code.
703:   *
704:   */
705: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
706: {
707: 	if(!mb_chnnl_init_ok)	/* if driver is not initialized. */
708: 	{
709: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
710: 
711: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
712: 
713: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
714: 		{
715: 			return ret_code;
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
720: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
721: 
722: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
723: 
724: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
725: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
726: 
727: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
728: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
729: 
730: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
731: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
732: 
733: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
734: 
735: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
736: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
737: 
738: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used)
739: 		return BK_ERR_OPEN;
740: 
741: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 1;		/* chnl in used. */
742: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param = callback_param;
743: 
744: 	return BK_OK;
745: }
746: 
747: /*
748:   * close logical chnanel.
749:   * input:
750:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to close.
751:   * return:
752:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
753:   *     failed  : fail code.
754:   *
755:   */
756: bk_err_t mb_chnl_close(u8 log_chnl)

765: 
766: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
767: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
768: 
769: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
770: 
771: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
772: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
773: 
774: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)

776:

779: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = NULL;
780: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = NULL;

787:   * read from logical chnanel.

793:   *     failed  : fail code.

795:   */
796: bk_err_t mb_chnl_read(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * read_buf)

801: /*
802:   * write to logical chnanel.
803:   * input:
804:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
805:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
806:   * return:
807:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
808:   *     failed  : fail code.
809:   *
810:   */
811: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
812: {
813: 	u16		write_len;
814: 
815: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
816: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
817: 
818: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
819: 
820: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
821: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
822: 
823: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
824: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
825: 
826: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
827: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
828: 
829: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
830: 
831: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
832: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
833: 
834: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
835: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
836: 
837: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
838: 
839: 	/* If the physical channel has been BUSY abnormally long (peer never
840: 	 * sent ACK / lost interrupt / lost ack), forcibly recover it so this
841: 	 * and all future mb_chnl_write() calls on the channel don't deadlock. */
842: 	{
843: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy_cb_chk = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
844: 
845: 		if ((phy_cb_chk->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY) && (phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms != 0))
846: 		{
847: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
848: 			u32 age = now - phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms;	/* unsigned wrap is fine for short windows */
849: 
850: 			if (age >= MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS)
851: 			{
852: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt++;
853: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;	/* mark "BUSY-stuck recovered" */
854: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
855: 				phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms = 0;
856: 			}
857: 		}
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
861: 	{
862: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
863: 
864: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
865: 	}
866: 
867: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
868: 
869: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
870: 
871: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
872: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
873: 	__DMB();
874: 
875: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
876: 
877: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
878: 
879: 	return BK_OK;
880: }

200: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
201: {
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
203: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
204: 	u16 			chnl_type;
205: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
206: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
207: 
208: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
209: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
210: 
211: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
212: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
213: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
214: 		return 4;
215: #endif
216: 
217: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
218: 		return 5;
219: 
220: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
221: 		return 3;
222: 
223: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
224: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
225: 
226: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
227: 		return 1;
228: 
229: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
231: 
232: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
233: 
234: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
235: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
236: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
237: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
238: 
239: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
240: 
241: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
242: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
243: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
244: 
245: 	__DMB();
246: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
247: 
248: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
249: 
250: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
251: 
252: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
253: 	{
254: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
255: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
256: 
257: 		return 2;
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
261: 
262: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
263: 
264: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
265: 	{
266: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	return 0;
270: }

272: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
273: {
274: 	u8		log_chnl;
275: 	u8		ret_code;
276: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
277: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
278: 
279: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
280: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
281: 
282: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
283: 
284: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
285: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
286: 
287: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
288: 
289: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
290: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
291: 		return;
292: 	}
293: 
294: 
295: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
296: 	{
297: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: 
302: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
303: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
304: 		return;
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
308: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
309: 
310: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
311: 	{
312: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
313: 		return;
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
317: 	{
318: 		if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
319: 		{
320: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
321: 			return;
322: 		}
323: 
324: 		log_chnl -= log_chnl_idx;
325: 
326: 		ack_ptr->hdr.data = 0;
327: 		ack_ptr->hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
328: 		ack_ptr->hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
329: 
330: 		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
331: 
332: 		if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
333: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x20;
334: 			return;
335: 		}
336: 
337: 
338: 		extern bk_err_t bk_mailbox_ready(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, uint32_t box_id);
339: 		if( bk_mailbox_ready(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx, MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL) != BK_OK)
340: 		{
341: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x40;
342: 			return;
343: 		}
344: 
345: 		// log_chnl = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl;
346: 		log_chnl += log_chnl_idx;  // don't change SRC-DST cpu-id, use only the chnl-id of tx_log_chnl.
347: 		if(log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl)
348: 		{
349: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x80;
350: 			return;
351: 		}
352: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"====mailbox reset!!%x, %x\r\n", log_chnl, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
353: 		
354: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
355: 
356: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
357: 
358: 		ack_ptr->data1 = phy_chnl_ptr->param1;
359: 		ack_ptr->data2 = phy_chnl_ptr->param2;
360: 		ack_ptr->data3 = phy_chnl_ptr->param3;
361: 	}
362: 	else
363: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
364: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
365: 	{
366: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
368: 
369: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
370: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
371: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
372: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
373: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
374: 		{
375: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
376: 			u8  i;
377: 
378: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
379: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
380: 
381: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
382: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
383: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
384: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
385: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
386: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
387: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
388: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
389: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
390: 					}
391: 					break;
392: 				}
393: 			}
394: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
395: 		}
396: 		return;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
400: 	{
401: 		/* clear following header members. */
402: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
403: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
404: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
405: 
406: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
407: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
408: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
409: 	} else {
410: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
414: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
415: 	{
416: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
417: 			break;
418: 	}
419: 
420: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
421: 	{
422: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
423: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
424: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
425: 		return;
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
429: 
430: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
431: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
432: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
433: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
434: 
435: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
436: 
437: 	if(ret_code != 0)
438: 	{
439: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
441: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
444: 
445: 	return;
446: 
447: }

449: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
450: {
451: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
452: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
453: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
454: 	u16 		chnl_type;
455: 
456: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
457: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
458: 
459: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
460: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
461: 
462: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
463: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
464: 
465: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
466: 
467: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
468: 		return;
469: 
470: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
471: 		return;
472: 
473: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
474: 		return;
475: 
476: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
477: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
478: 
479: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
480: 
481: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
482: 	{
483: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
484: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
485: 
486: 		return;
487: 	}
488: 
489: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
490: 	{
491: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
492: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
493: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
494: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
495: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
496: 
497: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
498: 
499: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
500: 	}
501: 	else
502: 	{
503: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
507: 	{
508: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
509: 		return;
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
513: 
514: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
515: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
516: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
517: 
518: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
519: 
520: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
521: 
522: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
523: 
524: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
525: 	{
526: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
527: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
528: 
529: 		return;
530: 	}
531: 
532: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
533: 	return;
534: }
535: 
536: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
537: {
538: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
539: 
540: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
541: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
542: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
543: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
544: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
545: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
546: 
547: 	/*
548: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
549: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
550: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
551: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
552: 	 */
553: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
554: 	{
555: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
556: 	}
557: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
558: 	{
559: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
560: 	}
561: }

563: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
564: {
565: 	u8		ret_code;
566: 
567: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
568: 
569: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
570: 
571: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
572: 
573: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
574: 		return;
575: 
576: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
577: 		return;
578: 
579: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
580: 
581: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
582: 	{
583: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
584: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
585: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
586: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
587: 
588: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
589: 
590: 		if(ret_code != 0)
591: 		{
592: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
593: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
594: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
595: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
596: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
597: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
598: 
599: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
600: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
601: 			}
602: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
603: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
604: 		}
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	return;
608: }

610: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
611: 
612: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
613: {
614: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
615: 	u16 			chnl_type;
616: 
617: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
618: 
619: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
620: 
621: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
622: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
623: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
624: #endif
625: 
626: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
627: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
628: 
629: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
630: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
631: 
632: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
633: 
634: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
635: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
636: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
637: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
638: 
639: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
640: 
641: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
642: 	
643: 	/*
644: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
645: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
646: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
647: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
648: 	 */
649: 	while(1)
650: 	{
651: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
652: 
653: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
654: 		{
655: 			break;
656: 		}
657: 	}
658: 
659: 	return ret_code;
660: }

663: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
664: /*
665:   * init logical chnanel module.
666:   * return:
667:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
668:   *     failed  : fail code.
669:   *
670:   */
671: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
672: {
673: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
674: 	int				i, j;
675: 
676: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
677: 
678: 	/*
679: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
680: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
681: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
682: 	 * can race here:
683: 	 *
684: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
685: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
686: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
687: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
688: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
689: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
690: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
691: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
692: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
693: 	 *
694: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
695: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
696: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
697: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
698: 	 */
699: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
700: 	{
701: 		return BK_OK;
702: 	}
703: 
704: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
705: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
706: 	{
707: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
708: 		return BK_OK;
709: 	}
710: 
711: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
712: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
713: 	{
714: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
715: 
716: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
717: 
718: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
719: 
720: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
721: 		{
722: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
723: 		}
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
727: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
728: 	{
729: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
730: 		return ret_code;
731: 	}
732: 
733: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
734: 
735: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
736: 	{
737: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
738: 
739: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
740: 	}
741: 
742: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
743: 
744: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
745: 
746: 	return BK_OK;
747: }

859: /*
860:   * write to logical chnanel.
861:   * input:
862:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
863:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
864:   * return:
865:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
866:   *     failed  : fail code.
867:   *
868:   */
869: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
870: {
871: 	u16		write_len;
872: 
873: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
874: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
875: 
876: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
877: 
878: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
879: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
880: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
881: #endif
882: 
883: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
884: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
885: 
886: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
887: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
888: 
889: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
890: 
891: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
892: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
893: 
894: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
895: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
896: 
897: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
898: 
899: 	/* If the physical channel has been BUSY abnormally long (peer never
900: 	 * sent ACK / lost interrupt / lost ack), forcibly recover it so this
901: 	 * and all future mb_chnl_write() calls on the channel don't deadlock. */
902: 	{
903: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy_cb_chk = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
904: 
905: 		if ((phy_cb_chk->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY) && (phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms != 0))
906: 		{
907: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
908: 			u32 age = now - phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms;	/* unsigned wrap is fine for short windows */
909: 
910: 			if (age >= MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS)
911: 			{
912: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt++;
913: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;	/* mark "BUSY-stuck recovered" */
914: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
915: 				phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms = 0;
916: 			}
917: 		}
918: 	}
919: 
920: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
921: 	{
922: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
923: 
924: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
925: 	}
926: 
927: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
928: 
929: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
930: 
931: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
932: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
933: 	__DMB();
934: 
935: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
936: 
937: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
938: 
939: 	return BK_OK;
940: }
941: 
942: /*
943:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
944:   * input:
945:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
946:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
947:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.
948:   * return:
949:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
950:   *     failed  : fail code.
951:   *
952:   */
953: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
954: {
955: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
956: 
957: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
958: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
959: 
960: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
961: 
962: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
963: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
964: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
965: #endif
966: 
967: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
968: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
969: 
970: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
971: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
972: 
973: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
974: 
975: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
976: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
977: 
978: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
979: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
980: 
981: 	switch(cmd)
982: 	{
983: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
984: 
985: 			if(param == NULL)
986: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
987: 
988: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
989: 			
990: 			break;
991: 
992: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
993: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
994: 			break;
995: 
996: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
997: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
998: 			break;
999: 
1000: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
1001: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
1002: 			break;
1003: 
1004: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
1005: 			if(param == NULL)
1006: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1007: 
1008: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
1009: 			return ret_code;
1010: 			break;
1011: 
1012: 		default:

1014: 			break;
1015: 	}

20: 	if(chnl >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)

30: 	}
31: 	else
32: 	{
33: 		return;
34: 	}
35: 
36: 	if(mailbox_callback[chnl] != NULL)
37: 		mailbox_callback[chnl](&data);

74: {
75: 	(void)arg;
76: 
77: 	mbox0_message_t message;
78: 
79: 	if(dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
80: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
81: 
82: 	if(data == NULL)
83: 	{
84: 		return BK_FAIL;
85: 	}
86: 
87: 	/*
88: 	int box = TX_CMD_BOX;
89: 
90: 	if(arg != NULL)
91: 	{
92: 		box = (*(uint16_t *)arg) & 0xFF;
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	if(box >= TX_BOX_NUM)
96: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_ID;
97: 	*/
98: 	
99: 	uint32_t fifo_status = 0;
100: 
101: 	int ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat((uint32_t)dst, &fifo_status);
102: 
103: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
104: 	{
105: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	if(RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL & fifo_status)
109: 	{
110: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;  // mailbox busy
111: 	}
112: 
113: 	mailbox_tx_box[dst] = (mailbox_tx_box[dst] + 1) % TX_BOX_NUM;
114: 
115: 	int box = mailbox_tx_box[dst];
116: 
117: 	memcpy(&mailbox_buff[dst][box], data, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
118: 	
119: 	message.data[0] = (u32)(&mailbox_buff[dst][box]);
120: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
121: 	message.dest_cpu = (uint8_t)dst;
122: 
123: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
124: 
125: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
126: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
127: 
128: 	return BK_OK;
129: }

361: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
362: {
363: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
364: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
365: 
366: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
367: 		ipc_init();
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
371: 		return BK_FAIL;
372: 
373: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
374: 
375: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
376: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
377: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
378: 
379: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
380: 
381: 	do
382: 	{
383: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
384: 		{
385: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
386: 			break;
387: 		}
388: 
389: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
390: 			cmd_len = 0;
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
393: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
394: 
395: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
396: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
397: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
398: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
399: 
400: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
401: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
402: 		{
403: 			break;
404: 		}
405: 
406: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
407: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
408: 		{
409: 			break;
410: 		}
411: 
412: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
413: 
414: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
415: 		{
416: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
417: 			break;
418: 		}
419: 
420: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
421: 		{
422: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
423: 			break;
424: 		}
425: 
426: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
427: 		{
428: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
429: 			break;
430: 		}
431: 
432: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
433: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
434: 
435: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
436: 
437: 	}while(0);
438: 
439: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
440: 
441: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
442: 
443: 	return ret_val;
444: 
445: }

122: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
123: {
124: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
125: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
126: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
127: 
128: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
129: 
130: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
131: 	{
132: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
133: 		{
134: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
135: 		}
136: 
137: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
138: 		{
139: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
140: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
141: 		}
142: 
143: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
144: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
145: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
146: 
147: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
148: 
149: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
150: 		{
151: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
152: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
153: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
154: 		}
155: 		else
156: 		{
157: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
158: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
159: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
160: 			{
161: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
162: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
163: 				#endif
164: 				__DMB();
165: 				
166: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
167: 
168: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
169: 			}
170: 			else
171: 			{
172: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
173: 			}
174: 		}
175: 
176: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
177: 
178: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
179: 
180: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
181: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
182: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
183: 
184: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
185: 
186: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
187: 	}
188: 	else
189: 	{
190: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
191: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
192: 
193: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
194: 
195: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
196: 		{
197: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
198: 		}
199: 		else
200: 		{
201: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
202: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
203: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
204: 			{
205: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
206: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
207: 				#endif
208: 				__DMB();
209: 				
210: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
211: 
212: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
217: 			}
218: 
219: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
220: 		}
221: 
222: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
223: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
224: 	}

228: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
229: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
230: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
231: 	 */
232: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
233: 
234: 	return;
235: 
236: }

## 审计结论

本次只读审计的实际板级目录为：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258`

用户所写的 `boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap` 位于 `board/beken/boards/...` 下。

总体判断：

| 模块 | 当前完成度 | 是否足以接 Wi‑Fi/BT |
|---|---:|---|
| mailbox v2 物理层 | 约 70% | 基本寄存器收发可用，但鲁棒性和生命周期 API 不完整 |
| logical channel | 约 35% | 只做了 HW_CTRL/PWC/UART0 三个发送槽和 PWC/UART0 两个接收分派，不是通用 logical-channel 层 |
| log/UART mailbox | 约 65% | 输出方向基本成形；没有 UART RX、正式 log channel、统计导出和完整错误恢复 |
| IPC/HW_CTRL | 约 15% | 只有 power-up/heartbeat 消息外形，没有 Armino IPC RPC/共享交换区/响应层 |
| PWC | 约 25% | boot-ready 能发送，RX 能排队；绝大多数电源命令是空处理 |
| Wi‑Fi IPC | 0% | 所需 channel 0x14/0x15 和 callback/completion API 均不存在 |
| BT IPC | 0% | 所需 channel 0x13 和 callback/completion API 不存在 |

因此，当前实现适合“AP 启动、mailbox console 输出、向 CP 报 boot-ready/heartbeat”的 bring-up 阶段；不能视为已经具备接入 `bk_avdk_smp` Wi‑Fi/BT 上层的 mailbox/IPC 基础设施。
